source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
subject: one visibly adult woman with long dark brown-to-black wavy hair parted near the center, brown eyes, an oval face, natural makeup, and a neutral focused expression, acquiring command of a coastal desalination plant's freshwater distribution hub
setting: nighttime emergency freshwater allocation hub inside a storm-struck coastal desalination plant
event: the outgoing controller places the brass master key and signed emergency authorization into her hands, she turns the key in the master console, the predecessor withdraws behind an authority line, technicians defer, and the visible potable-water routing changes under her control
visual_priorities: make the physical transfer and exclusive control position legible in one frame
make the controlled freshwater resource and changed allocation consequence legible in one frame
preserve only the reference's observable adult appearance without any identity claim
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic single-frame scene of visible acquisition of resource-control authority at a nighttime emergency freshwater allocation hub inside a storm-struck coastal desalination plant. One visibly adult woman has long dark brown-to-black wavy hair parted near the center, brown eyes, an oval face, natural makeup, and a neutral focused expression. She stands at the locked master console that controls the plant's potable-water allocation. At the decisive transfer moment, the outgoing controller places the brass master key and a signed emergency authorization folio into her hands. She turns the brass master key in the console's COMMAND socket while the outgoing controller steps behind a red authority line. Two technicians swivel their allocation boards toward her and await her signal. The central flow map changes from HOLD to ACTIVE, illuminated pipes route blue water toward three marked community tanks, and the main allocation dial rests under her hand. Preserve readable physical causality: the key and folio transfer, her exclusive control position, the predecessor's withdrawal, crew deference, and the water-routing consequence are all visible together.
